openings.claim: Stage/check complete kits before full assembly.
openings.probe: Counterbalance 12 builds across workers/layouts/workflows; time every stage; independently inspect contents.
openings.uncertainty: Switching versus complexity unresolved; bench space unverified.

openings.claim: Depict ordered layout and short-partition position.
openings.probe: Ten participants, five per diagram; balance layout/exposure; verified contents, usual shipping state; record completion, location errors, retries and sketch labor.

openings.claim: Outlines expose incomplete kits; matching labels guide placement; unassembled packing shifts insertion to customers.
openings.probe: Counterbalance stencil/ordinary checks across workers/layouts; time preparation and stages; test labeled kits with ten participants.
openings.uncertainty: Lookalike mismatches need marking; customer burden and packaging changes.

openings.claim: Removable compliant tongues convert resistance into seating/retention force.
openings.discriminator: Lower force/retries with stable, reusable joints.
openings.probe: Compare six modified/six unchanged samples, comparable board/slots; measure force, retries, loaded stability, rearrangement damage, template cost/time.
openings.uncertainty: Interference unproven; orientation errors, tearing, creasing and creep.

decision: Exploratory only; coordinate within 15 samples, ten participants and available time. Gate adoption on 30x20 cm footprint, same capacity, selected counts/colors, removable partitions, <=500 initial/<=0.40 recurring material costs and fixed delivery. Count all labor. Verify 60-order targets: >=98% complete, median <=8 minutes, >=90% unaided. Synthetic observations establish no mechanism.
